notes.title: Release Announcement - CYBER.one: Racing For Souls
notes.content:
Prepare for a dynamic adventure where every step is a challenge and every decision affects the fate of the world. Racing, skill challenges, and time-limited missions are just some of the challenges that await you.
Are you ready for the release date? Start your journey through the dead minds on April 19, 2024. Dark secrets, exciting challenges, and the fight for survival in a world that has been horribly transformed from what we once knew await you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36199498/51a0cbb0adbf21c3c8ddd90262f7a7e72f7d6449.png[/img]

notes.title: Release date
notes.content:
After many tests, we decided that the quality of the game still is differend from the vision of our team. For this reason, we have decided to postpone the release of the game to a later date.

We will use the time gained in this way to further work on the game and improve its quality. This is our top priority. We will inform you about the progress up to date and provide you with further details on our work.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36199498/fe81d3cf9cf8b06fbb7f5e716259898aaf299493.png[/img]

notes.title: News
notes.content:
1. In this GIF you can see a new skill which you can get in the game - parkour. At this moment it's pretty primitive and it works in a few locations only.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36199498/65d2b3b1967c9077567d80eebc8c660b040a5f21.gif[/img]

2. Although we are working all day and night, we have to change the launching date. Thank alot for your involvement and being with us. Voices of the lifeless souls are getting louder and louder.

3. Follow us on social media to see how CYBER.one: Racing For Souls is changing.
